description: This file defines the Concept class, a central domain model in the OpenMRS platform representing medical concepts, including their names, descriptions, answers, mappings, attributes, and relationships. It contains methods for managing concept names in multiple locales, answering concepts, concept descriptions, concept sets, and mappings, as well as support for localization, serialization, and domain-specific behaviors.

classes.name: Concept
classes.description: Represents a medical concept in OpenMRS, encapsulating its names, descriptions, answers, mappings, attributes, and relationships with other concepts. Manages localization, serialization, and various domain-specific behaviors related to medical concepts.

methods.name: getAnswers
methods.description: Returns all answers (including retired). Defaults to non-retired answers if no parameter specified.

methods.name: setAnswers
methods.description: Sets the collection of answers for the concept.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Adds a single ConceptAnswer to the collection, assigns it to this concept, and manages sort weight.

methods.name: removeAnswer
methods.description: Removes a specific ConceptAnswer from the collection.

methods.name: getConceptClass
methods.description: Returns the concept's class, such as 'finding' or 'procedure'.

methods.name: isSet
methods.description: Deprecated. Checks if the concept is a set (group of concepts).

methods.name: setSet
methods.description: Sets whether the concept is a set.

methods.name: getSet
methods.description: Returns whether the concept is a set.
